name: blockchain-patterns
description: Use this skill when asked about blockchain design patterns, token standards, upgradeable contracts, oracle patterns, layer 2 scaling patterns, cross-chain communication patterns, and common blockchain architecture patterns. Covers ERC standards (20, 721, 1155, 4626, 4337), proxy patterns (UUPS, transparent, beacon), bridge patterns, state channel patterns, sidechain patterns, and MEV-aware design. Do NOT use for: specific language implementation (use blockchain-application), core protocol design (use blockchain-core), or web3 integration (use blockchain-web3).
